page_title: LAZ 1-1 ATA | Lazio v Atalanta 28/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+4' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the left post.
90+3' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) produces a cunning chipped pass for Ademola Lookman, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
90+2' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
90+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. That's a free kick to Atalanta.
88' 1 - 1 Goal! Ademola Lookman puts the ball across the area and Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 1:1.
86' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
85' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
84' Here is a change. Sead Kolasinac is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
84' A substitution has been made. Taty Castellanos is replaced by Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio).
83' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
83' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
83' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

79' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall. A rebound sits up nicely for Taty Castellanos (Lazio) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the right post and out for a goal kick.

77' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Marco Carnesecchi anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

75' The ball from the resulting corner kick slipped through the box to Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), who instantly fires a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but his attempt is blocked. So unlucky. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
75' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) prepares to take a corner kick.
75' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
72' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
70' The referee is firm and issues Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) a deserved yellow card.
70' Mattia Zaccagni comes off the pitch to be replaced by Boulaye Dia (Lazio).
69' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
67' A player from Atalanta commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
66' A cross from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
65' The substitution is prepared. Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Charles De Ketelaere.
63' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Nuno Tavares is replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) will replace Loum Tchaouna.
62' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
61' The resulting corner from Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

61' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Ivan Provedel makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.

60' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
56' The substitution has been made. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) has replaced Mario Pasalic.
55' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is repeatedly being caught offside.
53' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
52' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
50' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) launches a cross from the corner, but Ivan Provedel is alert to thwart the effort.
46' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) comes off for Juan Cuadrado.
46' Half-time substitution. Isak Hien (Atalanta) will not participate anymore and Odilon Kossounou is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' The ball finds it way to Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to find Loum Tchaouna, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
42' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) receives a defence-splitting pass from Fisayo Dele-Bashiru and shoots early from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes well wide of the left post.
39' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
36' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

36' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
34' Isak Hien (Atalanta) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
34' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.
32' Ivan Provedel steps in and intercepts a long pass from Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta).
30' 7:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:1.

27' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) fires a brilliant volley into the middle of the net from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Nicolo Rovella provided the assist. What a finish! 1:0.
26' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
25' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
24' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Matteo Guendouzi slips the ball to Nicolo Rovella (Lazio), who hastily shoots from distance and sends the ball well wide of the left post.
23' One of the players from Atalanta times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
22' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) plays a one-two with Mario Pasalic, but the move breaks down.
21' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the left post.
21' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

20' A neat pass finds Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the top right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi denies him with a good save.
18' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
17' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
15' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes it short.
14' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivan Provedel, who smothers the ball.

11' OFF THE POST! Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

11' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
10' Ivan Provedel pulls off a brilliant save! Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved.
9' The ball is cleared after Taty Castellanos (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi is quickest to intercept the ball.
8' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is penalised for holding. Davide Massa signals a set piece.
7' Adam Marusic (Lazio) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Atalanta.
6' That was close. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
4' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
3' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The match has just started.
Atalanta will kick the game off.
Davide Massa is introduced as the referee for today's match.
